rules: exactly one Ink render instance is owned at a time
render() coalesces multiple calls during one pending flush into the latest dynamic frame while preserving every same-layout pending stable row batch
inline terminal output preserves stable transcript rows in native scrollback while lifecycle restores cursor and terminal modes on every exit path
exit paths: explicit exit, SIGINT, SIGTERM, SIGHUP, host EOF, render exception, unhandled rejection
terminal failures travel TuiErrorOut01TerminalFailure -> TuiErrorIn02StartupOutcome -> TuiErrorOut03ProcessExit and never map to success
child Cordis plugins do not have access to raw-mode or process-exit primitives; the lifecycle service owns all teardown
suspend()/resume() preserves the render instance and routes bracketed paste and resize while suspended
render() rejects nodes that carry transport frames, control metadata, raw SessionEvent, endpoint or sequence fields
state transitions are explicit; illegal transitions throw and never silently degrade
no fallback path, no silent strip, no fake success: a failing render exits through restore()
